scripts.build: npm exec --yes --package=pnpm@10.30.3 -- pnpm install --no-frozen-lockfile --unsafe-perm --config.allowBuilds.esbuild=true && npm exec --yes --package=pnpm@10.30.3 -- pnpm run typecheck && npm exec --yes --package=pnpm@10.30.3 -- pnpm -r --if-present run build
scripts.typecheck: pnpm run typecheck:libs && pnpm -r --filter "./artifacts/**" --filter "./scripts" --if-present run typecheck
scripts.mobile:add:ios: pnpm run app:build && cap add ios
scripts.mobile:sync: pnpm run app:build && cap sync ios
